versions.changelog:
- 修正官方 API 文档调用示例的接口地址为 https://gpt.juhe.cn/text2image/generate（原为 http://gpt.juhe.cn/text2image/generate）。
- 其余功能和说明保持不变，无其他内容改动。

- Initial release of "juhe-image-generate" skill.
- Generate AI images from text prompts with customizable styles, scenes, and aspect ratios.
- Supports automatic image download and provides a 24hr valid online link.
- Includes detailed instructions for API Key setup and script usage.
- Error handling for common API response codes and download issues.
- Comprehensive usage guide for prompt optimization and example commands.
